local.limits: The d673 source commit records these local results. No additional local Python, architecture or conformance result is inferred for that source.

regressions.aggregate_many_connections: 16 real UnixStream pairs share one 8 KiB test budget rather than independent per-socket budgets.
regressions.fair_cursor: 64 continuously ready real socket pairs are each serviced exactly once across eight 32 KiB budget windows.
regressions.exact_full_opportunity: Eight workers can each consume a complete 4 KiB bounded opportunity; a worker that merely empties the aggregate window is not classified as aggregate-blocked and remains eligible for health expiry.
regressions.actual_block_only: Health deferral is recorded only when aggregate allowance is smaller than the lane request, that allowance is exhausted and the read remains Pending; WouldBlock with unused bytes, completed frames, closure and malformed input do not gain extensions.
regressions.lane_specific_health: Control blocking alone can defer heartbeat; either control or progress blocking can defer progress because both observed control responses and work-progress events advance work progress.
regressions.blocked_worker_resume: A two-poll real UnixStream regression leaves an 8 KiB control frame half-read after only 4 KiB aggregate allowance remains, resumes at that blocked worker on the fresh window, completes the frame and restores heartbeat-expiry eligibility.
